description: P2.5 (PROGRAM_SYNTHESIS_PLAN.md): a BLOCKED PROGRAM READ IS A GAP THE AGENT FILES ON ITSELF -- the gap_awareness.json precedent pointed at the P2 reading frames. When a source upload's read path yields the honest residual {ok:False, blockers:[...]} (rust/lua correspondence walkers, python prog_ir_emit), the ADAPTER (domains/file_ingest._record_read_blocked) only records FACTS on the ingested UploadedDocument / function code-root node: read_blocked=1.0, read_blockers='comma,joined,kinds', frame='rust'|'lua'|'python' -- data, never a decision. THIS rule (note_prog_read_gap) DECIDES that a blocked read is a capability gap: it files SelfConcern{status:'noted', source:'implicit', kind:'prog_read', content:'<frame> read blocked: <blockers>'} -- the SAME node shape every gap_awareness rule mints, so the surfacing reader (reflective_faculty._run_self_gaps) and the human-gated promote spine (jabberwock_daemon.promote_self_concern -> StandingConcern) both find it with zero new plumbing. Content-deduped via the standard Not-Exists guard (the SAME blocked file ingested twice files ONE gap -- the content string is deterministic: frame + sorted blockers) + mint-once via prog_read_gap_noted on the document, exactly like every other gap rule. Match is the received upload Message's has_attachment edge (file_ingest._attach_message wires agent -received-> m -has_attachment-> doc), the single-anchor discipline. Installed idempotently by file_ingest._install_prog_read_gap_seed at source-ingest time (Seed/SeedSummary id check -- a load_all_seeds boot already holds it), so a lean upload-only agent still carries the rule.
